_source: Technique IDs, names and tactics transcribed from MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise (https://attack.mitre.org). Stored offline; URLs are shown as text only and never fetched.

T1110.001.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
T1110.001.summary: Adversaries guess passwords for a single account using repeated logon attempts.

T1110.003.name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
T1110.003.summary: Adversaries try one or a few common passwords against many accounts to avoid lockouts.

T1078.name: Valid Accounts
T1078.summary: Adversaries use credentials of existing accounts to gain or keep access.

T1098.name: Account Manipulation
T1098.summary: Adversaries modify accounts, e.g. adding them to privileged groups, to keep or raise access.

T1059.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter
T1059.summary: Adversaries abuse command and script interpreters to execute commands.

T1059.001.name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: PowerShell
T1059.001.summary: Adversaries abuse PowerShell, often with encoded or downloaded script content.

T1027.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
T1027.summary: Adversaries obfuscate content, e.g. base64-encoded PowerShell commands.

T1105.name: Ingress Tool Transfer
T1105.summary: Adversaries transfer tools or files from an external system into the environment.

T1003.name: OS Credential Dumping
T1003.summary: Adversaries dump credentials from the operating system, e.g. with Mimikatz.

T1003.001.name: OS Credential Dumping: LSASS Memory
T1003.001.summary: Adversaries access LSASS process memory to obtain credential material.

T1204.002.name: User Execution: Malicious File
T1204.002.summary: A user opens a malicious file, e.g. an Office document that spawns a shell.

T1070.001.name: Indicator Removal: Clear Windows Event Logs
T1070.001.summary: Adversaries clear Windows event logs to hide activity.

T1490.name: Inhibit System Recovery
T1490.summary: Adversaries delete backups or shadow copies to prevent recovery.

T1021.name: Remote Services
T1021.summary: Adversaries use valid accounts to log on to remote services across hosts.

T1039.name: Data from Network Shared Drive
T1039.summary: Adversaries collect data from network shares.

T1052.001.name: Exfiltration Over Physical Medium: Exfiltration over USB
T1052.001.summary: Adversaries copy data to removable USB media.

T1069.name: Permission Groups Discovery
T1069.summary: Adversaries look up group memberships (for example who is a domain admin) to find privileged accounts to target.

T1069.001.name: Permission Groups Discovery: Local Groups
T1069.001.summary: Enumeration of local groups such as Administrators, e.g. 'net localgroup administrators'.

T1069.002.name: Permission Groups Discovery: Domain Groups
T1069.002.summary: Enumeration of domain groups such as Domain Admins, e.g. 'net group "Domain Admins" /domain'.
